newsitem.title: UK: Caird gains on landfill site value report.
newsitem.headline: Caird gains on landfill site value report.

text.p: Shares in waste management group Caird Group Plc extended their recent surge on Monday after a report in the Mail on Sunday said the stock looked cheap against a background of increasingly scarce landfill sites.

The stock was up 35p at 665p in thin trade of 8,801 shares. It has leapt from 475p on September 4, the day before Caird posted first-half results showing a surge in net operating profit to 1.6 million stg from 0.3 million a year before.
The Mail report said full-year earnings per share of 70p looked possible and added that there were rumours of stakebuilding in the company.
"It's that report that has boosted the stock today," said one market-maker.
Shares in Waste Recycling Plc, also mentioned in the report, were up 3-1/2p at 218-1/2.

A new tax of seven stg a ton on waste dumped in UK landfill sites comes into force on October 1, increasing the cost to waste producers but possibly allowing waste management companies to increase profit margins.
